technique_name: Describe what it takes to be a successful manager.
description: A successful manager is one who has strong leadership and communication skills, the ability to think strategically, and the knowledge and experience to stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices. They should be organized and resourceful, with the ability to manage people, motivate employees, and inspire others.
